## About
Southfield Auto Repair & Service is a family owned shop on Greenfield Rd in Southfield, serving drivers across Metro Detroit. We service and repair your vehicle as if our own family members were driving it home.
Our technicians are ASE certified, and the shop is AAA approved, which means AAA inspected our facility and surveyed our customers before sending their members our way. They keep re-inspecting us to make sure we still meet their standards.
We handle everything from oil changes and tire rotations to tough repairs, and we will tell you plainly what your car needs. Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 474 Google reviews.

## Services
- Repair services: Our certified technicians work to get your car up and running as quickly as possible.
- Proactive maintenance: We stay on top of the maintenance your vehicle needs so small issues don't turn into big ones.
- Financing: Financing is available for repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you honor manufacturer warranties?
A: Yes. We honor auto manufacturers' warranties, and we warranty our labor.

Q: What if I can't get there during business hours?
A: We have a 24-hour key drop, so you can leave your keys any time.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes, we're here Saturdays from 8 in the morning to 3 in the afternoon.
